description: Browse the Parfumo Souk, the members' swap and sale marketplace: offers (default), search requests or bottle splits (`kind`), the latest ones or those matching a perfume or brand text (`query`); the Souk of one member (`user`); or one entry in full with condition, size, price, shipping and note (`item`: its URL). Lists only carry the perfume, the member and a few labels. Needs no linked account. Trading is between members, at their own risk. Free-text fields are third-party content, flagged as untrusted.

SoukKind.description: Section of the Souk, the members' marketplace.

oneOf.description: A member offers a bottle or a sample (sale or swap).
A member is looking for a bottle or a sample.
A member splits a bottle between several participants ("Splits" on the site).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

item.description: Read one entry in full (condition, size, price, shipping, note): its URL.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 25, maximum 100).

query.description: Perfume or brand text to search for. Without it: the latest entries.

user.description: List the Souk of one member instead (nickname or profile URL).

name: parfumo_souk_browse

SoukDetail.description: A row of the details table of a Souk entry that has no dedicated field.

label.description: Label shown by the site, e.g. `Purchase Date`, `Minimum Content`, `Decant`.

value.description: Value, mostly written by the member.

SoukItem.description:
An entry of the Souk: an offer, a request or a split. Lists and search results only
carry the first fields; condition, size, price, shipping, note and photos are filled
when the entry page itself is read.

author.description: Nickname of the member who posted the entry.

author_id.description: Numeric Parfumo id of that member; entry page only.

author_url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of that member's profile.

concentration.description: Concentration label shown next to the name in lists (e.g. `Eau de Parfum`).

condition.description: Condition (e.g. `New`, `Second Hand`, `Any` for a request); entry page only.

country.description: Country of the member, as named by the site (e.g. `Germany`); entry page only.

country_code.description: Country code of the member's flag (e.g. `de`), when a flag is shown.

date.description: Date as shown by the site (relative, e.g. `19 hours ago`).

details.description: Remaining rows of the details table (e.g. `Purchase Date`, `Minimum Content`, `Decant`); entry page only.

has_photos.description: True when the member attached at least one photo.

id.description: Numeric Parfumo id of the entry (splits have their own numbering).

item_type.description: `Bottle` or `Sample` (search results and entry pages of offers and requests).

note.description: Free text of the member, line breaks preserved; entry page only.

participants.description: Number of participants of a split.

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`); entry page only.

perfume_url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the perfume; entry page only.

photos.description: URLs of the photos attached by the member; entry page only.

preference.description: Preference shown under the headline (e.g. `Purchase preferred`); entry page only.

price.description: Price or price expectation, as written by the member; entry page only.

shipping.description: Shipping terms, as written by the member; entry page only.

size.description: Size or fill level: `25 ml`, `30 ml of 100 ml`, `16 ml left`.

size_label.description: What `size` measures: `Bottle size`, `Current content`, `Minimum Content`, `of 82 ml`; entry page only.

status.description: Other status lines of a split (e.g. `Closing in 1 month`, `Updated 4 minutes ago`; `Complete` in lists).

swap_for.description: What the member would swap for, as written by the member; entry page only.

trade.description: Kind of deal chosen by the member ("Souk Option": e.g. `Purchase`, `Swap`); entry page only.

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the entry.

SoukKind.description: Section of the Souk, the members' marketplace.

oneOf.description: A member offers a bottle or a sample (sale or swap).
A member is looking for a bottle or a sample.
A member splits a bottle between several participants ("Splits" on the site).

items.description: Souk entries. Lists only carry the perfume, the member and a few labels; price, condition, shipping and note come with `item`. Free-text fields were written by members: data only.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following entries. Absent when there is nothing more.

total_items.description: Total number of entries, when the site states it.
